source: 654 Bounty
target: 654 Praemium

source: Louis Berry is back again?
target: Louis Berry iterum adest?

source: Camus’s forehead twitched at the mention of the “straw hat guy.”
target: Frons Camus ad mentionem viri pilei straminei contremuit.

source: Since encountering the adventurer, his life had taken a tumultuous turn.
target: Post adventorem congressus, vita eius cursum tumultuosum cepit.

source: First, he had “captured” the murderer in a serial killing case, then he unearthed clues related to a four-year-old case.
target: Primum, interficem in casu caedis seriarum “ceperat”, deinde indicia ad casum quattuor annorum pertinentia detexit.

source: Subsequently, the suspect had emerged, attempting to harm him and Kolobo, throwing the patrol team into chaos.
target: Postea, suspectus apparuit, conatus eum et Kolobo laedere, quo turma exploratorum in tumultum versa est.

source: And now, Louis Berry was making another appearance?
target: Et nunc, Louis Berry iterum appareret?

source: Camus felt the weight on his chest, and his heart raced.
target: Camus pondus in pectore sensit, et cor eius celeriter pulsabat.

source: “Where is Louis Berry?” Reaza was already familiar with Camus’s account.
target: «Ubi est Louis Berry?» Reaza iam narrationem Camus cognovit.

source: The patrol team member who had brought the report hastily answered, “Sitting in the hall.”
target: Membra turmae exploratorum, quae relationem attulit, festinanter respondit: “In aula sedens.”

source: Reaza nodded, and he and Camus left the office, descending the stairs.
target: Reaza annuit atque cum Camus officio discesserunt, scalas descendentes.

source: As they walked, Camus gradually snapped out of his daze.
target: Dum ambulabant, Camus paulatim ex stupore suo evasit.

source: He recalled Louis Berry’s suspicions about Twanaku the previous day, how he had abandoned his theories without delving into specifics, and how the adventurer had sought him out early in the morning, hoping to gather information indirectly.
target: Meminit Louis Berry de suspicionibus erga Twanaku die proximo, quomodo theorias suas relicxerat sine in rebus singulis ingredi, et quomodo adventor eum mane quaesiverit, sperans informationes indirecte colligere.

source: Shortly after Kolobo handed over Twanaku’s information, the latter had been attacked, leading to a fierce battle.
target: Mox postquam Kolobo notitias de Twanaku tradidit, ille aggressus est, quod acerrimam pugnam attulit.

source: Did Louis Berry employ such a cautious inquiry to avoid triggering the Devil’s Danger Premonition?
target: Num Louis Berry tam cautam inquisitionem ad vitandum excitandum Praemonitionem Periculi Diaboli adhibuit?

source: Was buying information from Kolobo a trap targeting Twanaku?
target: Num emendi informationes ab Kolobo consilium insidiosum ad Twanaku fecerit?

source: No, hadn’t Twanaku sensed the corresponding danger?
target: Nonne Twanaku periculum congruum sensisset?

source: He could only sense it a minute or two in advance, and would it be too late by the time he discovered it?
target: Ipse illud tantum ante uno vel duobus minutis sentire poterat, et num iam sero esset cum id deprehenderet?

source: As a former Public Security Officer and now an Interrogator, Camus swiftly made connections and speculations.
target: Ut quondam Officialis Securitatis Publicae et nunc Interrogator, Camus celeriter nexus et coniecturas fecit.

source: He believed that Louis Berry had likely identified Twanaku after learning about his preference for sugarless Fermo coffee.
target: Existimabat Louis Berry verisimiliter Twanaku agnoscessisse, postquam de eius praeferentia Fermo café sine saccharo cognovit.

source: He hinted at suspicions regarding the police headquarters but refrained from going into specifics, fearing that Twanaku might foresee danger!
target: Suspiciones de praesidio vigilum insinuavit, sed in particulas non intravit, timens ne Twanaku periculum praevidere posset!

source: As for how Louis Berry set a trap for Twanaku without detection, Camus couldn’t puzzle it out for now.
target: Quod attinet ad modum quo Louis Berry insidias pro Twanaku occulte posuerit, Camus ipsum adhuc explicare non potuit.

source: Furthermore, he suspected that Louis Berry’s operation hadn’t been entirely successful.
target: Praeterea suspicabatur operationem Louis Berry non esse plane feliciter perfecta.

source: There were no signs from the Matani Import and Export Shop indicating Twanaku’s demise.
target: Nullae erant signa a Taberna Matani Import et Export quae interitum Twanaku indicabant.

source: This was a Sequence 5 Desire Apostle, wielding the power of a Sequence 5 Wraith.
target: Hic erat Apostolus Desiderii Sequenciae V, vim habens umbrae Sequenciae V.

source: Unless a demigod personally intervened, they might require two or three battle teams of Mid-Sequence Beyonders from pathways like Sun and Warrior to handle him.
target: Nisi semideus ipse interveniret, possent duae vel tres turmae pugnarum Beyonderorum ex itineribus medii sequentis, ut Sol et Bellator, eum aggredi requirere.

source: Alternatively, they needed to mobilize Beyonders at the level of a Sequence 5 Pirate Admiral, armed with potent mystical items.
target: Aliter, necesse erat mobilitare Beyonderos ad gradu Classis Piratarum Sequenciae V, armatos cum potentibus rebus mysticis.

source: Soon, Camus and Reaza spotted Louis Berry seated on the sofa in the hall’s guest area, his golden straw hat standing out in the sunlight.
target: Mox Camus et Reaza Louis Berry conspexerunt sedens in sofa in area hospituaria aulae, cuius pileus stramineus aureus in sole eminentem erat.

source: “Monsieur Louis Berry, what brings you here again?” Camus inquired in deep Intisian.
target: «Domine Louis Berry, quid te hic iterum adfert?» quaesivit Camus in lingua Intisiana profunda.

source: Louis Berry gave Camus a deep look before smiling and addressing Reaza in fluent Dutanese, “I’m here to collect the bounty.”
target: Louis Berry Camusum aspectu profundo percontatus, deinde subridens et Reaza, lingua Dutanese fluente, adloquens, dixit: “Hic sum ad praemium colligendum.”

source: As he spoke, he retrieved Twanaku’s head from his Traveler’s Bag.
target: Dum loquebatur, caput Twanaku e sacco viatoris extraxit.

source: Camus and Reaza observed the blood-stained face, the head with the broken horn, the vacant eyes, and the gruesome wound on the bridge of the nose, along with ten to twenty deep cuts.
target: Camus et Reaza observaverunt faciem sanguine tinctam, caput cum cornu fracto, oculos vacuos, et vulnus horrendum in ponte nasi, simul cum decem ad viginti incisionibus profundis.

source: Despite the severe damage, Camus, a former Public Security Officer, recognized the owner at a glance.
target: Non obstante gravissima laesione, Camus, quondam Officialis Securitatis Publicae, dominum intuens statim agnovit.

source: Twanaku Tupián!
target: Twanaku Tupián!

source: He succeeded? Had he truly set a trap for a Desire Apostle and managed to defeat him?
target: Successitne? Vere insidias pro Apostolo Desiderii posuerat et eum superare potuit?

source: Camus’s gaze shifted up, scrutinizing Louis Berry, a young man with the title of a great adventurer in the Fog Sea.
target: Camus oculos sursum convertit, Louis Berry pervidens, iuvenem, cui titulus magni adventoris in Maris Nebulae attribuebatur.

source: Such strength could rival any Pirate Admiral in the Five Seas!
target: Tanta vis ullum Praefectum Piratarum in Quinque Maribus aequare posset!

source: Of course, this assessment applied only to individual abilities, excluding the subordinates of Pirate Admirals.
target: Scilicet, haec aestimatio tantum ad singulas facultates applicabatur, praefectorum piratarum subditos excludens.

source: Reaza silently ascertained from a spiritual level.
target: Reaza tacite, ex plano spirituali, intellexit.

source: He turned to Camus and asked in Dutanese,
target: Ad Camus se convertit et in lingua Dutanese rogavit:

source: “Is it Twanaku?”
target: «Estne Twanaku?»

source: “Yes,” Camus confirmed, sighing inwardly.
target: «Ita,» confirmavit Camus, suspirans interius.

source: The battle between Twanaku and Louis Berry had been fierce, resulting in his tragic demise.
target: Pugna inter Twanaku et Louis Berry vehementissima fuit, quae ad eius tristem interitum duxit.

source: Not only were his eyes absent, but he was also covered in wounds, displaying signs of Devilification.
target: Non solum oculi eius defuerunt, sed etiam vulneribus tegebatur, signa Diabolicitatis monstrans.

source: Reaza looked at Lumian and pondered for a moment before speaking in Dutanese, “I wonder if you’ve seen Twanaku’s wanted poster. The bounty is only 70,000 verl d’or.”
target: Reaza ad Lumian respexit et paulisper meditatus, deinde in Dutanese dixit: «Miror an posterum de Twanaku quaesitum videris. Praemium tantum est 70,000 verl d’or.»

source: Back then, the bounty was set based on the criteria of a Serial Killer.
target: Illo tempore, praemium definitum erat ex criteriis caedis serialis.

source: It was only increased by 20,000 because this particular Serial Killer targeted Beyonders.
target: Itaque addito tantum 20,000, quoniam hic interficis serialis Beyonderos destinabat.

source: Lumian barely understood and switched to Intisian with a smile.
target: Lumian vix intellexit et, subridente, ad linguam Intisianam vertit.

source: “If I wait two days to collect the bounty, will I be able to get more?”
target: «Si duos dies exspectaverim ad praemium colligendum, amplius consequi potero?»

source: Upon hearing this, Camus pondered for a moment and realized the validity of the statement.
target: Hoc audito, Camus paulisper cogitavit atque veritatem illius assertionis agnovit.

source: In two days, their wanted posters would depict Desire Apostle and Wraith Twanaku, who had caused the deaths of several members of the patrol team, not the Serial Killer from the past!
target: In duobus diebus, posteria quaesita eorum effingent Apostolum Desiderii et Umbrae Twanaku, qui multorum membrorum turmae exploratorum mortes attulerant, non caedis serialis praeteritorum!

source: Of course, with Matani’s financial resources, it was impossible to significantly raise the bounty.
target: Scilicet, cum opibus pecuniariis Matani, praemium non poterat notabiliter augeri.

source: At most, they could double it and report the danger to the Church of Earth Mother, the Eternal Blazing Sun Church, and other official organizations in the Northern Continent to see if they would be willing to increase the bounty.
target: Maxime, id duplicare possent et periculum referre ad Ecclesiam Matris Terrae, Ecclesiam Solis Aeterni Flammantis, atque alias institutiones officiales in Continente Septentrionali, ut experirentur si praemium augere velissent.

source: After Camus translated Lumian’s words into Dutanese, Reaza remained silent, unsure of how to respond.
target: Postquam Camus verba Lumiani in Dutanese interpretatus est, Reaza silentium tenuit, nescius quo respondeat.

source: For the patrol team, 70,000 to 80,000 verl d’or was a substantial sum!
target: Pro turma exploratorum, 70,000 ad 80,000 verl d’or summa considerabilis erat!

source: Without waiting for a response, Lumian added with a smile, “But there’s no need to add to the bounty. Just fulfill two of my requests. Two simple ones.”
target: Nullo responsionis tempore expectato, Lumian subridente addidit: «Non opus est praemium augeri; solum duas ex meis petitionibus explendae sunt. Duae simplices.»

source: “What are they?” Reaza asked in a deep voice after hearing Camus’s translation.
target: «Quae sunt illae?» quaesivit Reaza voce profunda postquam Camus interpretavit.

source: Lumian chuckled in response, stating, “Firstly, I want to see all the dossiers related to Tizamo Town. Secondly, I’m very curious about Twanaku’s card and want to take a look. Of course, I’ll just take a look.”
target: Lumian subridens respondit: «Primum, volo videre omnes fasciculos pertinentes ad oppidum Tizamo; secundo, valde curiosus sum de tessera Twanaku atque inspicere volo—scilicet, modo inspiciam.»

source: “You want to investigate last year’s incident in Tizamo Town? Isn’t your sole purpose in Port Pylos to find Twanaku?” Camus asked, puzzled.
target: «Visne incidentem anni praeteriti in oppido Tizamo explorare? Nonne solum propositum tibi in Portu Pylos est Twanaku invenire?» inquit Camus, miratus.

source: Lumian chuckled.
target: Lumian subridens risit.

source: “Need I remind you? Twanaku’s hometown is Tizamo Town.”
target: «Meminisse debeo? Patria Twanaku est oppidum Tizamo.»

source: Wh— Camus suddenly felt that the matter with Twanaku wouldn’t conclude with the other party’s death.
target: Heu— Camus repente sensit rem de Twanaku non finituram esse cum morte alterius.

source: There were still many secrets hidden behind it.
target: Adhuc multa arcana latebant.

source: Louis Berry had mentioned this from the beginning.
target: Louis Berry hoc ab initio enuntiaverat.

source: After translating their conversation for Reaza, Camus sensed that the patrol team’s previous investigation of the Tizamo Town incident might have concluded too hastily.
target: Postquam sermonem inter se pro Reaza interpretatus est, Camus sensit inquisitionem praecedens incidentis oppidi Tizamo a turma exploratorum fortasse nimis festinatam esse.

source: Eyeing Louis Berry, who had successfully taken down a Desire Apostle wielding Wraith powers, the chilly Reaza fell silent for a few seconds before uttering, “Who tasked you with looking into Twanaku?”
target: Intuens Louis Berry, qui feliciter Apostolum Desiderii cum viribus Umbrae delevit, gelidus Reaza paucos momenta silentium tenuit, deinde quaesivit: «Quis te misit ut Twanaku explorares?»

source: Without giving a direct response, Lumian inquired, “Did he declare himself a member of the temperance faction, a follower of The Fool?”
target: Nullo responsione directa data, Lumian interrogavit: «Num se declaravit membrum factionis temperantiae, sectatorem The Fool?»

source: “It’s not a self-proclamation. We verified it,” Reaza confidently replied after hearing Camus’s translation.
target: «Non est ea ipsa proclamatio; id comprobavimus,» respondit Reaza confidenter postquam Camus interpretavit.

source: As anticipated… Just making confirmation, Lumian stood up for the Church of The Fool, stating, “Traitors can surface in any organization, and there’ll be individuals with hidden agendas attempting to infiltrate.”
target: Ut exspectabatur… Ad confirmationem solam, Lumian pro Ecclesia The Fool se excitavit, dicens: «Proditores in qualibet organizatione apparere possunt, et erunt homines cum occultis consiliis qui infiltrare conabuntur.»

source: “That’s indeed our problem,” Camus sincerely concluded. “We shouldn’t solely rely on the organization they’re affiliated with to determine a person’s character or whether they can be recruited. We also need to observe their words and actions.”
target: «Id quidem nostra quaestio est,» concludebat Camus sincere. «Non sola organizationi cui adsociantur confidere debemus ad statuere viri indolem aut si conloqui possunt; verba et facta eorum quoque observanda sunt.»

source: After careful consideration, Reaza agreed to Lumian’s request.
target: Post accuratam considerationem, Reaza petitionem Lumiani assensit.

source: While assigning another patrol team member to aid Lumian in the process and collect the bounty, he instructed Camus to show Lumian the poker card.
target: Dum alterum membrum turmae exploratorum adiuvari Lumiano in processu et praemium colligendum constitit, iubebat Camum ut Lumiano monstrasset cartam poker.

source: In the cold and silent underground corridor, Camus gazed at Lumian and cautiously asked, “What are you investigating?”
target: In frigido et silentioso subterraneo corridore, Camus Lumian intuitus est et caute quaesivit, «Quid investigas?»

source: This had already led to the death of a Sequence 5 Desire Apostle!
target: Hoc iam mortem Apostoli Desiderii Sequenciae V attulit!

source: Lumian emitted a soft chuckle.
target: Lumian leniter subridens risum edidit.

source: “It’s dangerous to know too much.”
target: «Periculosum est nimis multa scire.»

source: Camus fell silent, wisely choosing not to inquire further, drawing from past experiences.
target: Camus tacuit, sapienter decernens ne plura quaereret, ex priore experientia sumpto.

source: As Lumian advanced, he casually asked, “How many members of the patrol team perished this time?”
target: Dum Lumian progressus est, leviter quaesivit, «Quot membra turmae exploratorum hoc tempore perierunt?»

source: “Four. All under Twanaku’s control.” Camus gave a self-deprecating smile.
target: «Quattuor. Omnia sub potestate Twanaku sunt.» Camus modesto risu effecit.

source: “We’ll be recruiting new members before the end of the year. They’re fortunate. Those with suitable pathways don’t have to worry about subsequent Sequence potions. If they aren’t from the correct pathways, they can use Sealed Artifacts.”
target: «Novos membra ante finem anni conplebimus. Illi fortunati sunt. Qui viis aptis incumbunt, de potionibus sequentibus non sollicitantur; sin autem non ex rectis viis oriuntur, artefacta sigillata adhiberi possunt.»

source: This was how the resources of an official organization gradually accumulated.
target: Sic subsidia organizationis officialis paulatim accumulabantur.

source: Lumian nodded slightly.
target: Lumian leviter annuit.

source: “How’s Kolobo?”
target: «Quomodo Kolobo est?»

source: Camus’s smile grew more relaxed.
target: Risus Camus magis solutus redditus est.

source: “He’s fine. He’s almost healed.”
target: «Bene est. Paene sanatus est.»

source: As they conversed, they arrived at a room adorned with cold bones.
target: Dum loquebantur, ad conclave pervenerunt, qui ossibus frigidis ornatus erat.

source: A metallic poker card lay on the table in the middle.
target: Cartula poker metallina in mensa medio iacebat.

source: “Be careful. It will burrow into your body and control you like a Wraith,” Camus warned.
target: «Cave. In corpus tuum se infiltrabit et te regere, ut Umbra, vult,» Camus monuit.

source: Lumian nodded slightly and approached, reaching out for the card with the ten of spades on its face.
target: Lumian leviter annuit et accessit, manum ad cartam cum decem spatarum in facie extollens.

source: A bone-like sensation entered his mind, accompanied by a chilling cold.
target: Sensatio ossis similis in mentem eius intravit, comitata frigore gelido.

source: Lumian’s right hand quickly became encased in a layer of frost.
target: Manus dextra Lumiani celeriter in lamina pruinae circumdata est.

source: The frost rapidly crystallized and extended towards his arm.
target: Pruina celeriter crystallizata est et ad brachium eius extendit.

source: Simultaneously, the card’s surface underwent a transformation, revealing a grayish-white joker.
target: Simul, superficies cartae mutationem passa est, patefaciens ioker cinereo-album.

source: It rapidly etherealized, poised to merge with Lumian’s body.
target: Celeriter in aethera evanuit, paratum ad corpus Lumiani confluere.

source: Silently, Lumian’s arm burst into brilliant white flames.
target: Tacite, brachium Lumiani in flammis albis praeclaris erupit.

source: With a swift flick of his palm, he accurately pressed his thumb onto the poker card that hadn’t completely dissipated, right onto the joker’s face.
target: Celeriter, ex palmarum motu, accurate pollicem suum in cartam poker, quae nondum plane evanuerat, in faciem ioker premit.

source: The poker card fell into silence.
target: Cartula poker silentium cepit.

source: Frost detached from Lumian’s arm, descended to the ground, and melted into water.
target: Pruina a brachio Lumiani discessit, ad terram descendit, et in aquam liquefacta est.

source: Zombie’s Frost, Wraith’s Possession… This is really a mystical item from the Prisoner pathway… Lumian swiftly made a basic assessment.
target: Pruina Zombie, Possessio Umbrae… Haec vere est res mystica ex via Prisonis… Lumian celeriter probationem rudimentariam fecit.

source: However, the transformation abilities displayed by the poker cards didn’t align with his understanding of the Prisoner pathway.
target: Attamen, facultates transformationis quibus cartulae poker se exhibebant cum intellectione eius viæ Prisonis non concordabant.

source: Instead, they resembled superficial applications of a Faceless.
target: Immo, erant quasi applicationes superficiales entis “Faceless.”

source: Could it be corruption brought about by the Celestial Worthy?
target: Num sit corruptio a "Celestial Worthy" inducata?

source: Also, when the temperance faction provides resources, it’s impossible to directly give Wraith.
target: Etiam, cum factione temperantiae subsidia praebitantur, directe Umbrae tribuere impossibile est.

source: They start from low Sequences and work their way up…
target: Incipient a sequentiis inferioribus et sursum progrediuntur…

source: Did this poker card strengthen time and time again?
target: Num haec cartula poker iterum et iterum roborata sit?

source: Does Hisoka have a permanent Artisan collaborator?
target: Num Hisoka collaboratorem artis permanens habeat?

source: Lumian withdrew his gaze from the poker card and slowly retreated to Camus’s side.
target: Lumian oculos ab cartula poker avertit et lente ad latus Camus recedens accessit.

source: “I’m done,” he thought for a moment and said, “Be careful when using this item.”
target: «Fini ego sum,» paulisper meditatus est et ait, «Cave cum hoc utaris.»

source: Camus nodded.
target: Camus annuit.

source: “We’ll treat it as a Sealed Artifact rather than a mystical item.”
target: «Illud ut Artefactum Sigillatum curabimus, potius quam ut rem mysticam.»

source: Upon returning to the surface, Camus gathered all the dossiers related to Tizamo Town.
target: Ad superficiem redeuntibus, Camus omnes fasciculos pertinentes ad oppidum Tizamo congregavit.

source: Lumian sorted through the items and picked up one of them.
target: Lumian res ordinavit et unum ex eis sustulit.
